stories.title: Room setup quick-start
stories.story: As a First-Time Planner, I want a quick-start setup for room dimensions and door/window defaults, so that I can begin layout work without guessing.
acceptanceCriteria: A new workspace offers a guided setup path for room dimensions.
The setup path can be skipped without blocking manual editing.
The generated room state is valid and compatible with import/export.
agentHints: Keep geometry stored in centimeters in state.
Route all mutations through App update flow.
Add tests for new setup defaults and validation logic.

stories.title: Clearance and collision helper
stories.story: As a Precision Optimizer, I want visual warnings for blocked paths and tight clearances, so that I can iterate on practical room arrangements faster.
acceptanceCriteria: Warnings appear when configured clearance thresholds are violated.
Warnings update during object movement without freezing interactions.
Warnings can be toggled in preferences.
agentHints: Keep high-frequency interaction logic efficient in RoomCanvas.
Prefer pure utility functions for rule evaluation and unit tests.

stories.title: Saved layout snapshots
stories.story: As a Repeat Workspace Manager, I want named snapshots for each room, so that I can compare options and safely return to prior versions.
acceptanceCriteria: User can create, rename, and restore room snapshots.
Snapshot restore works with undo/redo expectations.
Snapshot data persists through autosave and workspace export/import.
agentHints: Document persistence schema changes in workspaceState migration.
Validate import/export compatibility in workspaceFile tests.

stories.title: Persona-based onboarding presets
stories.story: As a First-Time Planner, I want onboarding presets based on my planning style, so that I get relevant defaults and tips quickly.
acceptanceCriteria: User can pick a planning style during onboarding.
Preset selection applies defaults without locking future edits.
agentHints: Keep presets additive and avoid hidden state mutations.

stories.title: Guardrailed title/meta optimizer using Search Console data
stories.story: As a Repeat Workspace Manager, I want a guardrailed service that evaluates approved homepage title/meta variants using Search Console performance and recommends the best option, so that SEO copy improves over time without risky manual guesswork.
acceptanceCriteria: A scheduled job can ingest Search Console data for configured pages/queries and ignore windows that are too recent for stable data.
A variant registry supports pre-approved title/meta options with minimum impression and confidence thresholds before any winner is selected.
Selection logic only recommends a winner when CTR improves without a material average-position regression, otherwise no change is applied.
The workflow outputs a traceable decision record and opens a PR with proposed metadata changes instead of directly mutating production.
The optimizer supports manual kill-switch and rollback to the last known good metadata variant.
agentHints: Keep SEO copy truthful and avoid manipulative or cloaked variants.
Metadata currently lives in index.html and build-generated SEO assets; keep both in sync.
Prefer PR-based rollout and auditable logs over fully autonomous deploys.
Add targeted tests for decision thresholds and no-change guardrails.

stories.title: Dedicated landing page with FAQ and comparison matrices
stories.story: As a First-Time Planner, I want a dedicated landing page with clear value copy, FAQs, and honest comparison tables, so that I can quickly understand why this tool is the best fit and start planning.
acceptanceCriteria: The site has an indexable landing experience focused on search intent, with clear navigation to the planner tool.
Landing content includes FAQ sections that reflect real product behavior and is eligible for FAQ structured data where appropriate.
Comparison matrices against relevant alternatives are factual, maintained, and include clear feature differences.
Primary call-to-action paths from landing sections open the planner in one click and are measurable with analytics events.
Landing copy and metadata are consistent with product capabilities and avoid exaggerated claims.
agentHints: Preserve existing app behavior while introducing landing-page structure.
Keep metadata, schema, and on-page copy aligned and truthful.
Update tests/build checks for any routing or rendering changes.

stories.title: Account-free share links for in-progress layouts
stories.story: As a Repeat Workspace Manager, I want to generate shareable links for my current layout without creating an account, so that I can get feedback and bring people back to the site.
acceptanceCriteria: Users can create a share link from the current workspace without authentication.
Opening a share link restores the shared layout state reliably in the app.
Share flow includes an explicit option to copy the link and a clear return path to continue editing on the site.
Shared-link behavior preserves import/export compatibility and does not corrupt autosaved local work.
The implementation documents limits and privacy considerations for shared data.
agentHints: Preserve workspace import/export contracts in workspaceFile utilities.
Keep state mutation flow centralized through App-level updates.
Add targeted tests for shared-link encode/decode and migration edge cases.
